findings.title: Interpolation ACTIVATION wiring (draw_packets alpha branch + main.odin accum->alpha) has no automated pin — the feature can silently deactivate with every gate green
findings.detail: P1: the 13 new pins call packet_interp_pos directly; goldens render alpha=1.0. draw_packets' `interp_alpha: f32 = 1.0` is a DEFAULT PARAM — dropping the arg at the call site compiles green, kills the glide, and passes every gate. The PR's entire purpose is unpinned liveness.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin the activation: extract main.odin's alpha computation into a testable helper + unit pin, and add an rlsw-driven render test asserting the drawn pixel position at alpha=0.5 (catches branch/arg removal).

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
findings.detail: P0 100% (4/4: snapshot-exact default — 47 demos green; +15% size — 38 re-blessed T2s; motion.dem T1; interp core pins). P1 67% (4/6 — activation wiring + app alpha computation untested). Overall 57% (8/14 — trail ring, echo draw, tooling at 0%). P1 <80%, overall <80% -> FAIL.
findings.recommended_fix: Deliver B1's activation pin + W2's trail-ring assertions; wire `odin test app/render` into .github/workflows/ci.yml (W1). P1 -> >=90%, overall -> >=80%: PASS.

findings.title: The new motion pins run only in the LOCAL CI mirror — the GitHub workflow never executes `odin test app/render`
findings.detail: ci.yml's only unit-test step is `odin test core`; the 13 pins (all 28 render tests) execute via tools/ci-local.sh gate 2 only. Remote green does not enforce them, and ci-local.sh's step-for-step mirror claim is already divergent (pre-existing for hud/wire_path; this PR adds claim-relevant pins to the unenforced side).
findings.recommended_fix: Add `odin test app/render` (with app/input, app/audio, harness test suites) to ci.yml, or reconcile the mirror claim. Briefing-flagged: verified the tests are NOT dead files — they run locally and pass.

findings.title: Trail echo ring mechanics have zero automated coverage — r1 B2's fix prescription explicitly listed 'trail order' and it was not delivered
findings.detail: Ring fill order, drop-oldest shift, the 0.5px move gate, echo lag, and fades[trail_n-1-k] indexing never run under any gate (goldens alpha=1.0; motion_test binds the trail returns with `_`). A regression ships silently.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend motion_test: drive packet_interp_pos across successive frames asserting trail_n growth, ring order (oldest..newest), lag behind the live pos, stationary no-push, and full-ring shift.

findings.title: The 'delivery snap' pin doesn't test delivery — interp_continuous never reads p.delivered; the assertion passes via the anchor mismatch
findings.detail: The delivered flag is inert in the predicate; the test passes only because at_node(2) != entry_heading(1). Production is SAFE (draw_packets:1386 `if p.delivered { continue }` skips before interp), but the file-header claim 'every teleport (…delivery) is FALSE' is not what the test pins.
findings.recommended_fix: Either add `if p.delivered { return false }` to interp_continuous + a test with at_node == heading, or rename the test (e.g. anchor-mismatch-at-node) and drop the delivery claim from the header/README.

findings.title: STILL PRESENT since r1, sharpened: motion-strip's third Demo_Replay/driver copy has NO mechanical drift safety net — the 'T1 manifest pins it' comment is aspirational on this path

findings.title: motion.dem header calls 2200..2450 'the strip window' while every reproduce command runs 2200..2600
findings.detail: Self-contradictory wording: 'the 2200..2450ms strip window is therefore the pure mid-edge glide; the tail of the window (2450ms+)…' — the window is 2200..2600; only the glide sub-range ends at 2450. Residual sloppiness from the r1 F3 rewrite.
findings.recommended_fix: Reword: 'the 2200..2600ms strip window: 2200..2450 is the pure mid-edge glide; 2450+ the post-arrival tail'.

findings.title: measure_packet_motion.py: --xmax without a value crashes with a raw IndexError traceback (reproduced)
findings.detail: `int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--xmax") + 1])` — trailing --xmax raises IndexError (non-numeric: ValueError) despite the documented W3/W4/W7/W12 hardening pass. Perkins reproduced the crash live.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard arity + int-parse with a clean stderr message, return 2 (or argparse).

findings.title: motion-strip ms args have no upper bound — i64 overflow wraps end_tick/prime_from
findings.detail: Validation bounds only the lower end; end_ms ≳ 4.6e17 makes i64(end_ms)*20 wrap negative -> max(0,..)=0 -> premature 'no frames rendered' exit. Degenerate-input note.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject ms args above a sane ceiling (end_ms*hz within i64) alongside the range check.

findings.title: packet_interp_pos persists the from_screen (0,0) fallback when scale <= 0, smearing the next tick's glide base
findings.detail: A zero-size/minimized window during Run (alpha<1) stores cur=(0,0) world; after restore the identity-continuous packet lerps from the map corner for one tick (anchors unchanged -> no snap). Self-heals on the next roll.
findings.recommended_fix: Skip the cache write when v.scale <= 0 (render snapshot-exact, like alpha=1) so a degraded frame never seeds the glide base.
